Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Scope of work 1) Manpower Requirement Number of dedicated Skilled Manpower- 6 No. Duty Hours of dedicated Skilled Manpower- 8 Hrs. Working days in a week for Skilled manpower- 7 days Number of dedicated managerial/ Supervisory staff required – 1 No. Duty Hours of dedicated Skilled Manpower-8 Hrs. Working days in a week for Skilled manpower-2 days 2) Routine Work at Plant Site i. Daily Cleaning of influent Bar Screen Cleaning of Oil and grease trap. ii. Regular checking of the control panels, MCC panels for any abnormalities, Regu lar switching of the Blowers. iii. Regular dosing of chemicals in the system and adjust as prescribed in the Oper ation Manual of STP. iv. Ensure the effluent inlet and effluent discharge and water discharge meters ar e always functional. v. Routine backwash of MGF and ACF. vi. Cleaning and tightening of all screw connections and terminals on controllers. vii. Checking, Maintenance and CIP of Membrane at routine intervals. viii. Examining of fuse contacts and terminals for cleanliness and tightness. ix. Checking if the voltage fluctuation is within the permissible limit. x. Checking of current rating and actual loading of motor to prevent overloading b y frequently monitoring the ammeter reading. xi. Checking the gland packing once in two months. xii. Checking the valves and pressure gauges and tightening the gland at closer intervals when too much leak of water occurs. xiii. Checking the exhaust pump, its auxiliaries and impeller periodically. Operatin g of submersible pump once a week, and its maintenance. 3) Repairing & replacement of spare parts in STP plant as and when req uired.

i. Filter media replacement if required. ii. Air blower filters Repairing or Replacement if required. iii. Repairing of Pumps and Motors including spare parts. iv. Repairing of Air Blowers. v. Repairing of Electrical panels including replacement of spare parts. vi. To provide Lubricant and Belt for air blowers. vii. Measuring flasks. viii. Repairing/replacement of bearings, pressure gauges, gaskets, gland packing, nut bolts and washers of machineries. ix. Any other machineries/Pumps repairing or spare parts replacements in STP. x. All the materials, spare parts, consumable such as oil, grease etc. will be provided contractor. 4) Observation of the Functionality and Performance of the Plant and Re cord the Data i. Colour and concentration of the influent wastewater. ii. Presence of grease balls or any signs of high concentration of Fat, Oil and Grea se. iii. To check colour of the mixed liquid and biological tanks. iv. Adequate mixing in the biological tank. v. Take of sample of mixed liquid from the aeration tank and do settling test as p er IS Standard. vi. Check the quality of sludge at the bottom of the aeration and waste if necessar y. vii. Check the floating scum and floatable in the final effluent tank. viii. Check for leakages in the dosing system and rectification. ix. Remove any floatable from all the tanks. x. Clean all strainers with hard brush and remove any non-bio-degradable materia l. 5) Entries in Log Book i. Flow meter Reading total Treated water. ii. MLSS levels by settling test iii. pH of Aeration tank iv. DO level of Aeration tank v. pH of inlet and outlet effluent

6) Blowers Monitoring i. Check the cartridge for blockage and replace if necessary. ii. Remove any surface deposit. iii. Check for any deviation in the normal operating conditions which are a sign of operation that can lead to failure. iv. Check lubrication of bearings etc. v. Maintain operationality of all the tanks and pipelines and electrical installations. vi. The instruction given to the Contractor from time to time should be properly c arried out and necessary records of action taken should be maintained in a Log B ook. 7) Cleaning of STP Components Cleaning of tanks and other STP components shall be carried out at required inter vals as per operational requirements. This shall include, wherever applicable: a. All Tanks b. Chambers c. Screens d. Filters e. Pipelines f. Valves g. Aeration systems h. Other associated components 8) Electrical System Regular inspection and maintenance & repair of electrical equipment associated with the STP shall be carried out, including: a. Electrical control panels b. Starters c. MCBs d. Contactors e. Switches f. Cables

g. Motors h. Other associated electrical components 9) Preventive maintenance The contractor shall prepare and follow a preventive maintenance schedule for all STP equipment. The preventive maintenance shall be carried out at appropriate i ntervals to minimize breakdowns and ensure uninterrupted operation. 10) Breakdown Maintenance Any breakdown affecting the operation of the STP shall be attended to immediate ly. The contractor shall take necessary corrective measures to restore normal operat ion at the earliest. 11) Other Services a. Training i. The Training Plan and schedule of operation (SOP) shall be prepared. ii. This training will cover a demonstration of all procedures necessary to operate and maintain all equipment and systems on a continuous basis. iii. The agency shall arrange for theoretical as well as practical training to both su pervisors and staff adequately. iv. An SOP of the Equipment operation, adjustment, maintenance to be provided by the agency which should be the part of training and displayed in the plant are a. v. Health and Safety: Emphasize the importance of adhering to health and safety regulations and include protocols for managing hazardous materials, personal pro tective equipment (PPE) requirements, and safety training. b. Emergency response i. The agency immediate will take steps in the incident of the emergencies such a s equipment failures, chemical spills, or other incidents. Include emergency conta ct information and escalation procedures. c. Sampling i. Samples of raw sewage should be taken from sewage sumps or from the deliver y side of the sewage pumps through the sampling cocks. ii. Sample of treated water should be taken from permit section line or treated wa ter tank. iii. Contractor has to carry out the testing of water at the interval of every month and whenever felt necessary as instructed to do so by the department and furnis h the test reports to the Engineer-In-charge on priority. The Contractor will also pr ovide a Tests Certificate every month of effluent water before and after treatmen

t and the certificate must be obtained from the NABL approved Lab. The effluent results should be within CPCB standard limit. (As per latest norms). iv. Digested sludge may be drawn from the sampling points of the sludge line of t he delivery pipe to dewatering system. v. Excess dry sludge shall be given to third party for disposal/use by Client. vi. It is the responsibility of the agency, that the operation of STP plant should alw ays be smooth under the available load of sewage. vii. Any damages caused by the Contractor in existing facilities while carrying out the work shall be made good by the contractor to our entire satisfaction at their o wn risk and cost. d. For above work the contractor provide the experts and required manp ower/materials/parts/chemicals as below: i. 03 No. of operator for each plant to operate the Plant for 08 hrs. per day. for 07 days of week with provision of rest relievers. ii. 01 No. of Manager/Supervisor for each plant for biweekly visit or as and when r equired. iii. Company’s backup, senior engineers, experts of any major problems, general checkup of maintenance and advice, chemicals, consumable, lubricants, oiling & greasing of the equipment, once in a month and whenever required. The agency will be responsible for procuring chemicals, spare parts, and other ne cessary supplies, specify the procurement process, quality standards and lead ti mes at their own cost. e. Safety and PPE The contractor shall ensure all necessary safety measures, PPE, safety equipment and safe working practices for operators and maintenance personnel. The contractor shall provide suitable PPE including, as applicable: a) Safety shoes. b) Safety helmet. c) Hand gloves. d) Safety goggles. e) Face mask. f) Safety jacket. g) Other appropriate safety equipment. ons of bid.
